universe: Polymarket 'highest temperature in <city> on <date>' events, closed, end date within the 46 days before 2026-10-21; all 51 city series
truth: official winning bucket (outcomePrices). Station = the one named in the event description (ICAO from weather.gov site= or Wunderground URL; Hong Kong Observatory for HK)
split: events sorted by local date; dates <= median date = CALIBRATION (first half), later dates = EVALUATION (second half). No PnL is computed on calibration events.

forecast.source: Open-Meteo previous-runs API (best_match), hourly temperature_2m_previous_dayN at the station lat/lon, daily max over the local calendar day
forecast.no_lookahead_rule: use N = ceil((L + 6) / 24) for decision lead L hours (N=1 for L=6,12; N=2 for L=24,36): every hourly value used was issued >= 6h before the decision time, assuming the previous_dayN value for hour h comes from a run initialised about 24*N hours before h
forecast.units: converted to the market unit (F or C)

error_model.truth_proxy: midpoint of the winning bucket (open-ended buckets: edge -/+ 1 unit)
error_model.bias: per city and per N: mean(forecast - truth)
error_model.sigma: per N pooled over cities: stdev of (forecast - bias - truth), floor 0.8 unit
error_model.distribution: Normal(forecast - bias, sigma); bucket probability integrates over [lo - 0.5, hi + 0.5) to reflect whole-degree rounding; open-ended buckets integrate to +/- infinity; probabilities renormalised to sum to 1

strategy.price_proxy: last CLOB /prices-history point (fidelity 60) at or before the decision time for the bucket YES token
strategy.fee: shares * rate * p * (1 - p) from the market feeSchedule (rate defaults to 0.05 if missing)
strategy.entry_condition: model_prob - entry_price >= 0.10 and entry_price <= 0.60 and entry_price >= 0.02
strategy.payout: $1 per share if bucket won, else 0

report: calibration table (model prob deciles vs realized)
share of traded buckets with total volume >= $1,000 (proxy for $10-$50 fill capacity)
look_ahead_checks: forecast issue time vs decision time (rule above)
archive (ERA5) daily max at station vs official bucket for label mismatch rate
